summary.intent: Finish trail #178 by updating PR #430 (test-only spec assertion gaps), then start trail #180: have the release workflow post a comment on the held release PR explaining why it is held.
summary.outcome: PR #430 title and body were edited. On a new branch feat/release-pr-hold-note, a shared note script, a rebuild-note script, hold-script wiring, workflow edits, a new test, a justfile hook, and spec/docs updates were written. The new test, the existing hold test, policy and pin checks, and shellcheck -x pass. The final spec JSON and workflow-contract verification was run but its result isn't shown, and nothing was committed or pushed.

repo: Workflow contract checks live in .github/tests/ (test-hold-release-pr.sh, verify-release-workflow-policy.sh, verify-action-pins.sh, verify-release-workflow-contract.sh) and are run via `just workflow-contracts`; new shell tests must be added to that justfile recipe.
Release behavior is specified in docs/specs/release.json and documented in docs/releasing.md, so workflow changes need matching spec and doc edits.
The repo does not run shellcheck in the justfile or workflows, but the release scripts pass `shellcheck -x`; plain shellcheck without -x flags sourced files.
Scripts such as release-pr-note.sh are both sourceable and runnable; sourcing only defines the function, so test harnesses must call it explicitly.
GITHUB_SHA is already provided by GitHub Actions, so workflows don't need to set it in env.
Spec-criterion test PRs in this repo use no changeset when no code changes, and reference the entire.com trail in the PR body.

code.finding: This range contains the step where the release PR refresh runs, which is where the rebuild note hook was added.

workflow: Check `gh pr list --head <branch> --state all` to find the PR number for a branch before editing it.
Run the linters the repo uses (actionlint, zizmor, shellcheck -x) after workflow and script changes; actionlint output needed filtering for noisy 'ref is missing' lines.

friction: The first run of the new test failed four cases because sourcing the note script only defines the function and the harness never called it.
Plain shellcheck flagged issues that went away only with -x, and the first shellcheck pass required follow-up edits to hold-release-pr.sh and note-release-pr-rebuild.sh.
actionlint output on the workflows was noisy and had to be grepped down.
open_items: Confirm the result of the final `verify-release-workflow-contract.sh` and spec JSON validation, which is not shown in the transcript.
Commit, push, and open a PR for branch feat/release-pr-hold-note (trail #180).
Weakly asserted criteria from trail #178's second list are deferred until a real regression could slip through them.
The edits landed in the worktree path .claude/worktrees/macos-15-runners rather than a dedicated worktree for this branch, which may be worth tidying.
